history.summary: 1,550sf 3BR at Elias Green (Pasir Ris, D18 OCR; TOP 1992, 99LH from 1991 → ~64yr left, 419 units on a 517k sf site) asking $1.56M / $1,006psf. The ask sits at the top of this project's own same-size prints (May-26 $1.55M 1,550sf fl 06-10; 2026 1,528sf prints $1.47-1.55M; Aug-26 1,615sf $1.61M), so fair is about $1.50-1.55M: fairly priced, not cheap. Without a collective sale the numbers are ordinary: ~1.75% net carry, a lease down to ~57yr at a 7-yr exit, 1.3km to Pasir Ris MRT, and Elias CRL not before ~2032. The upside is a third en bloc attempt at $883M (plot ratio 1.4→1.8, gazetted MP2025), but the 2018 and 2025 attempts both failed, the 2025 one with no bids at all.
history.rating_rationale: Neutral, not Buy. At $1.56M the ask is about 1-4% over fair on the project's own same-size prints (fair ~$1.50-1.55M). The −11% age-adjusted discount is mostly a lease/sub-market level, not value: the 1,550sf layout has never printed above $1.55M. As an investment it is thin: ~3.1% gross / ~1.75% net yield on URA project rents (median $4,250 on 53 contracts in the 1,500-1,600sf band), and the lease will be ~57yr at exit, which will thin the next buyer's CPF/loan pool. REALSCORE 3.0 with 80.3% profitable on 276 resale pairs (avg 4.2%/yr) is a weaker downside record than OCR peers at 85-99%. What keeps it off Avoid is that the price is fair and the en bloc option is real and free-ish: $883M over 419 units is ~$2.1M per unit on average, well above resale. That option already failed twice (2025 drew no bids), and the committee was still collecting 80% consent as of Mar-2026, so treat it as a lottery ticket, not a thesis. At ~6 near-identical $1.55-1.56M asks sitting since July, there is room to negotiate: ~$1.48-1.50M would move it toward the fair-value floor.

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: URA project rents for the 1,500-1,600sf band over 2025-26: median $4,250 (53 contracts, $1,550-5,800). The algo's $3,996 (capped) is slightly conservative. Gross ~3.1-3.3%, net ~1.75-2%. That is carry, not a return engine.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: URA 5yr CAGR 3.83% on 36 txns (1,550sf layout: $1.26M Sep-21 → $1.55M May-26, ~4.5%/yr) partly reflects en bloc speculation around the 2025 attempt. Momentum is −0.37. On the de-weighted trailing-return prior and a shrinking lease, expect ~2-3%/yr excluding en bloc. The en bloc is a binary upside, not a base case.
agent_evaluation.stack_notes: No profile. Floor level undisclosed on the listing. At this size the 06-10 and 11-15 floors printed the highest ($1.50-1.55M); a 01-05 unit at this ask would be overpriced (Sep-26 1,507sf fl 01-05 cleared $1.41M).
